notes: The Operating Model panels (Model / Attribution / Interpretation) are replaced in the terminal by an analysis built on the full pricing basket: the WEIGHTED MODEL OF MODELS. The premise: the market prices every name on SOME frame — earnings power, asset value, growth cash flows, a multiple — and which frame it is using is readable from which model's value series TRACKS the price series. The weights are the finding; the blend is the model. - Walk-forward correlation weights, per stock, adaptive over time. At each quarterly date, each model's trailing-12-observation Pearson ρ of ln(model value)
